entries.title: John 2:1
segments: Two days after this there was a wedding at Cana in Galilee, and Jesus' mother was there.

entries.title: John 2:2
segments: Jesus himself, too, with his disciples, was invited to the wedding.

entries.title: John 2:3
segments: And, when the wine ran short, his mother said to him: "They have no wine left."

entries.title: John 2:4
segments: "What do you want with me?" answered Jesus. "My time has not come yet."

entries.title: John 2:5
segments: His mother said to the servants: "Do whatever he tells you."

entries.title: John 2:6
segments: There were standing there six stone water-jars, in accordance with the Jewish rule of 'purification,' each holding twenty or thirty gallons.

entries.title: John 2:7
segments: Jesus said to the servants: "Fill the water-jars with water;"

entries.title: John 2:8
segments: And, when they had filled them to the brim, he added: "Now take some out, and carry it to the Master of the Feast." The servants did so.

entries.title: John 2:9
segments: And, when the Master of the Feast had tasted the water which had now become wine, not knowing where it had come from--although the servants who had taken out the water knew--

entries.title: John 2:10
segments: He called the bridegroom and said to him: "Every one puts good wine on the table first, and inferior wine afterwards, when his guests have drunk freely; but you have kept back the good wine till now!"

entries.title: John 2:11
segments: This, the first sign of his mission, Jesus gave at Cana in Galilee, and by it revealed his glory; and his disciples believed in him.

entries.title: John 2:12
segments: After this, Jesus went down to Capernaum--he, his mother, his brothers, and his disciples; but they stayed there only a few days.

entries.title: John 2:13
segments: Then, as the Jewish Passover was near, Jesus went up to Jerusalem.

entries.title: John 2:14
segments: In the Temple Courts he found people who were selling bullocks, sheep, and pigeons, and the money-changers at their counters.

entries.title: John 2:15
segments: So he made a whip of cords, and drove them all out of the Temple Courts, and the sheep and bullocks as well; he scattered the money of the money-changers, and overturned their tables,

entries.title: John 2:16
segments: And said to the pigeon-dealers: "Take these things away. Do not turn my Father's House into a market-house."

entries.title: John 2:17
segments: His disciples remembered that Scripture said--'Zeal for thy House will consume me.'

entries.title: John 2:18
segments: Upon this the Jews asked Jesus: "What sign are you going to show us, since you act in this way?"

entries.title: John 2:19
segments: "Destroy this temple," was his answer, "and I will raise it in three days."

entries.title: John 2:20
segments: "This Temple," replied the Jews, "has been forty-six years in building, and are you going to 'raise it in three days'?"

entries.title: John 2:21
segments: But Jesus was speaking of his body as a temple.

entries.title: John 2:22
segments: Afterwards, when he had risen from the dead, his disciples remembered that he had said this; and they believed the passage of Scripture, and the words which Jesus had spoken.

entries.title: John 2:23
segments: While Jesus was in Jerusalem, during the Passover Festival, many came to trust in him, when they saw the signs of his mission that he was giving.

entries.title: John 2:24
segments: But Jesus did not trust himself to them, since he could read every heart,

entries.title: John 2:25
segments: And because he did not need that others should tell him what men were; for he could of himself read what was in men.
